description: This file contains unit tests for the FrameMap class, particularly testing its methods like getFramesRange, getEntriesRange, and getFullTraceFramesRange, using a FrameMapBuilder to set up test cases.

methods.name: getFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the range of frames that overlaps with the specified start and end, or undefined if no overlap.

methods.name: getEntriesRange
methods.description: Returns the range of entries that overlaps with the specified start and end, or undefined if no overlap.

methods.name: getFullTraceFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the full range of trace frames.
